name: TCC Steel Corp.
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, TCC Steel Corp. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of steel products. Its offerings, utilized in numerous applications, include tinplate, tin-free steel, nickel-plated steel, copper-plated steel, super tin, and laminated steel. The company maintains a significant international footprint, with its products being exported to approximately 60 countries worldwide. Established in 1959, the firm was formerly known as Dongyang Tinplate Corp., rebranding to TCC Steel Corp. in March 2003.
